label: Collapsible Row
purpose: An individual expandable row within a Collapsible Content section
_notes: Distinct from the existing 'collapsible-row' block (a different real Liquid file, blocks/collapsible-row.liquid) — this is blocks/collapsible-row-content.liquid, used specifically inside the collapsible-content section. `icon` is a Material Symbols icon name (free text), not an enum. Real schema also supports pulling content from a linked Shopify page (a `page` setting) — omitted here since Phase 6's validator has no hallucination guard for that reference type yet (only product_picker/collection are covered); representing it now would mean either an unprotected reference field or expanding Phase 6 validation, both out of scope for this phase.
